title: Steelley P NDE 9784
content: I was working on my friend's car on the side of the road. The car fell off the jack and onto my chest and arms. I was trapped for about 90-120 seconds and lost consciousness after I was pulled out from under the car. I regained consciousness when my buddy slapped my face and gave me some water. During unconsciousness, I saw my life from when I was an infant with memories I didn't even know I had. I also saw 'future' memories of my kids grown up and my wife with another man. But I was completely at peace with death and spending eternity in heaven. There was almost an aura around my memories and visions. I specifically remember watching my two friends lift the car off of me and dragging me out from under it. I was life-flighted to the trauma center and spent 7 hours there. I had no issues immediately. Since then, I was diagnosed with acute stress syndrome, and then PTSD. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: June 20, 2020 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes. Accident. Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I saw my friends talking and helping me get out from under the car. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I felt numb but at peace. No pain, no breathing. Just experience and watching At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Probably watching my friends help me, and then the memories and visions Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. The memories and visions were slow and vivid. The out of body watching friends was fast and quick Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Clear. Crisp. Detailed. No thoughts or vision other than what I was seeing. It was as if I was honed in. Every day vision is clustered, hard to focus for me personally Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could hear everyone but me. I could hear my friends, I could hear my wife, and sons and daughter laugh. I could hear their cries. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Almost like an aura surrounding the things I saw Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? Sadness, peace, Happiness, joy Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? I remembered many past events Memories and visions I didn't know I had locked up in my head. Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future. I saw my wife, oldest son, and daughter's futures. I was watching my daughter walk down the aisle at her wedding. I was watching my son graduate. I saw my unborn son growing up with his mother and another man, like it was almost just a shadow. I had visions of a 4th child but it was just my wife being extremely happy. It was crazy. I now have four kids. The two previously mentioned. My wife was 5 months pregnant at the time with our third child, and we now have a fourth child as well. Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Other Christian Independently fundamental Baptist Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I changed how I view others and the things they go through. Everyone has a story, including me now. Everyone goes through trials and tribulations. I'm more loving and compassionate towards others and the issues they deal with. Big or small. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Yes I felt the presence of the Lord. But not in a I saw Him. Just that overwhelming feeling of peace and comfort the Bible describes Christ as giving. During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes I knew I was where I was supposed to be at that time. I didn't get there by chance. And I didn't live by chance either. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes I believe what I was shown, was that my family needed me. I was working 80 hours a week at the time and what was shown was things I was missing or would miss either dead or alive if I didn't change During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I obviously believe in the afterlife with the Lord. But the overwhelming sense of joy, peace and understanding confirmed what I already knew. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? My wife and I went through some trouble due to me not knowing how to register my emotions for a year after the accident. Therapy and reliance on the Lord has helped. Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes It was almost like I sounded crazy to even share what I saw and felt during that time. Almost other dimensional. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I do not know how my remembrance of the experience compares to my remembrance of other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? My scars. Constant reminder of the event, and where I was and where I should be. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I shared with my wife probably one year after the event. She wasn't moderately influenced, as she is strong in her faith anyways. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably real I didn't believe I was actually still alive for about 2 days. I couldn't comprehend all that I went through, knowing the survival rate for incidents like that. But I didn't think I was crazy or just imagined it either. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No ln6rtt1_nde

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Felt the presence of the Lord (not seen), described as an overwhelming feeling of peace and comfort.
arrival.other_being_detail: Sensed presence of beings but did not see them.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car fell off the jack onto chest and arms; trapped ~90–120 seconds; lost consciousness after being pulled out.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Personal future visions (children grown, wife with another man).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE observing friends lifting car, then slow vivid memories/life review and future visions.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Future visions included wife with another man; also a vision of a 4th child (later had four children).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I clearly left my body and existed outside it.”; “I was completely at peace with death and spending eternity in heaven.”; “There was almost an aura around my memories and visions.”
